reason: B offers the more physically credible and testable intervention: Al-assisted coherent γ′ precipitation in a Ni-rich FCC matrix, with defined composition, aging, baseline, property targets, and microscopy/mechanical falsification. Its novelty is weakened because the cited Ni-Co-Fe-Cr-Al-Ti study already demonstrates essentially this strategy, but A is less viable because simple oxidizing exposure is unlikely to generate a uniform, fine internal Y2O3 dispersion and may instead cause external or grain-boundary oxidation and embrittlement.
